scenes.say: Want admission in a Kendriya Vidyalaya? Here is the complete guide for parents, class by class.

items: More than a thousand schools across India
scenes.say: Kendriya Vidyalayas are central government schools that follow the CBSE syllabus. There are more than a thousand of them across India, and the fees are low.

For Balvatika and Class 1, registration is online, usually in March and April. Children are selected by lottery within priority categories. For Class 1, the child must be at least six years old on the cut-off date.

items: Children of central government employees first
Then central PSU and state government staff
Reserved seats under RTE and for SC, ST, OBC
scenes.say: Children of central government employees get the highest priority. Next come central P S U and state government staff, and then all other families. Some seats are also reserved under the Right to Education Act, and for SC, ST and OBC children.
For Class 2 and above, admission is only where seats are vacant. You register at the school itself, usually in April.

items: Depends on the streams the school offers
scenes.say: For Class 11, admission happens after the Class 10 results, based on marks and the streams the school offers.

items: Read this year's notice on the KVS website
Register online and fill in the form
Visit the school with original documents
scenes.say: To apply for Class 1, read this year's notice on the K V S website, register online, fill in the form and upload the documents. Then check the lottery lists, and if your child is selected, visit the school with the original documents.
Keep these documents ready: the birth certificate, residence proof, the parent's service certificate if you claim priority, and a category certificate if you have one.
On Marg Disha dot com, open Schools and choose K V to see when forms usually open for each class, with the official link.
Everything is free on Marg Disha dot com, in English, Telugu and Hindi. Subscribe for more guides like this.
